title: Write Point Cloud
text: Write point cloud data to a ROS or ROS 2 message, 4 inputs, 1 output, {Select color field} sets Color field for the point cloud image; {Write to Intensity field} sets the write intensity values. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: RGB
ports.summary: RGB values for each point matrix | array

ports.name: Alpha
ports.summary: Alpha channel for input image N -by-1 vector | h -by- w matrix

ports.name: Intensity
ports.summary: Intensity values for each point matrix | array

ports.name: Msg
ports.summary: ROS or ROS 2 point cloud message nonvirtual bus

params.name: Select color field
params.values: Color field for the point cloud image none (default) | rgb | rgba
